cookies.name: Cookie Run India
cookies.description: Cookie Run India (stylized as CookieRun India) is a side-scrolling endless runner developed by Devsisters and published by Krafton. It is a heavily reworked version of Cookie Run for Kakao localized for the Indian market, featuring many UI, UX, and quality of life features. It was released on December 11th, 2024.

cookies.skill: Blooming Dancheong Cookie was baked from gat-kimchi, made by grinding plum blossoms that bloomed in the snow and seasoning them over mustard leaves. Born from ingredients that overcame biting winds and solitude, this Cookie came to possess a spirit both resilient and noble. To create a land where Cookies could thrive, Blooming Dancheong Cookie gathered the energy of the Five Colors, swept away the heavy clouds, and planted a colossal plum World Tree on Mount Kimchi, the peak closest to the sky, linking heaven and earth as one. Warm sunlight and the gentle fragrance of plum blossoms soon began to fill the barren land. A world that had once been silent slowly became alive with the laughter of Cookies, and Blooming Dancheong Cookie, accompanied by the Plum Blossom Dragons, continued to watch over them. Though the tale now lives on only as a legend, a lone shrine is said to still be standing at the summit of Mount Kimchi, where Blooming Dancheong Cookie is worshipped as a mountain spirit.

However, the magnetic aura is weaker compared to Angel Cookie's magnetic aura (Holy Feather +9 is presumably almost the same as Level 2 Angel Cookie). The treasure's ability can be stacked, for example with the Random Boost item 'Magnetic Aura' or Fairy Cookie's Power+ to create a stronger effect. The treasure can be effective for obtaining boosts and coins that are in difficult or tight corners for cookies who do not have the aura.

treasures.name: Certificate of Playing the New World
treasures.description: Certificate of Playing the New World is an S-grade certificate treasures. It can be obtainable only from reaching the all-time high score of 1-999,999 points in previous three seasons of Cookie Run. In other words, only players who played Cookie Run before 18 December 2014 will receive this. The treasure will be automatically rewarded when the player logs in after a new season of Cookie Run. Currently, the player could only receive one certificate treasure (logging in at season 4).
